heading: Civil action by Attorney General for equitable relief
lead: The Attorney General may bring a civil action in the United States District Court for the District of Columbia for appropriate equitable relief if the foundation—

tree.text: engages or threatens to engage in any act, practice, or policy that is inconsistent with the purposes in section 90102 of this title; or
refuses, fails, or neglects to carry out its obligations under this chapter or threatens to do so.

notes.text: Amendments2014—Pub. L. 113–237, § 3(c)(6)(B), renumbered section 152609 of this title as this section. Par. (1). Pub. L. 113–237, § 3(c)(6)(C), substituted “section 90102” for “section 152602”.
